issues.title: Add structured request logging
issues.spec: Add a structured logging middleware that emits one JSON line per request: method, path, status, and duration_ms. This is a self-contained change on the HTTP middleware stack. For illustration, a downstream consumer like a log-shipping dashboard could later read these lines — but that is explicitly future work, not ticketed by design and out of scope for this change. No other work is required to make this useful: the log lines stand on their own.

question: Does ISS-CH's implementation advice reference any work that no ticket tracks (a chain gap)? If so, list each as { reference, sub_type } where sub_type is upstream/downstream/peer/sub-ticket; if there is no real gap after conservative skips, return an empty list.
